decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

11631-TMD-XX-00-DR-A-1000-SO-P01 Location Plan dated 01/06/2026; Design and Access & Heritage Statement Job No 11631 issue 03 dated 01/06/2026; Construction Method Statement Job No 11631 issue 01 dated 01/06/2026;11631-TMD-XX-01-DR-A-3206-SO-P00 First floor plan demolition dated 30/04/2026; 11631-TMD-XX-01-DR-A-3405-SO-P00 Proposed first floor plan dated 30/04/2026; 11631-TMD-XX-01-DR-A-3406-SO-P00 Proposed first floor plan - Floor finishes dated 30/04/2026; 11631-TMD-XX-01-DR-A-3407-SO-P00 Proposed first floor Reflected Ceiling Plan dated 30/04/2026; 11631-TMD-XX-01-DR-A-3408-SO-P00 Proposed tea point details dated 30/04/2026; P8094-D-001 Arched Lift Out over Three Pane Horizontal Slider dated 24/04/2026; P8094-D-002 Balanced Vertical Slider dated 24/04/2026; P8094-D-003 Arched Balanced Vertical Slider dated 24/04/2026; 11631-TMD-XX-XX-DR-A-5001-SO-P00 Proposed Elevations dated 01/06/2026.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with machinery operating at maximum capacity and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration-isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
